+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks in Windows stderr with their text."""
+    header = b"\r\nCLIXML\r\n"
+    if header not in stderr:
+        return stderr
+
+    result: list[bytes] = []
+    position = 0
+    while True:
+        marker = stderr.find(header, position)
+        if marker == -1:
+            result.append(stderr[position:])
+            break
+
+        result.append(stderr[position:marker])
+        content_start = marker + len(header)
+        end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", content_start)
+        if end == -1:
+            # Incomplete blocks, including ones spanning lines, stay untouched.
+            result.append(stderr[marker:])
+            break
+
+        content_end = end + len(b"</Objs>")
+        original = stderr[marker:content_end]
+        clixml_data = stderr[content_start:content_end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                decoded = (b"#< CLIXML\r\n" + clixml_data).decode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                decoded = (b"#< CLIXML\r\n" + clixml_data).decode("cp437")
+            replacement = _parse_clixml(decoded.encode("utf-8"))
+        except (ET.ParseError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
+            result.append(original)
+        else:
+            result.append(replacement)
+        position = content_end
+
+    return b"".join(result)
+
